title: Today tab: saved recipes first, plus a Try something new entry
summary: The first tab is now Today: a greeting, an at-a-glance entry to your recipes, up to three saved picks with favourites first, and a Try something new card presenting the existing Suggest flow behind the same readiness gates. The saved-recipe collection is one canonical pushed root with a single Add/import sheet owner, Add and timer chrome live on exactly the two roots, and Search no longer pops the stack. Native final-head compile and device screenshots remain UNRUN.
